rationale: Filesystem-spec has distinct registry, utility/compression, and core open-path surfaces. Core URL resolution and OpenFile behavior consume registry lookup, protocol parsing, path expansion, and compression contracts, producing clear stale-interface risks. The evaluator deliberately scopes out the much larger backend and AbstractFileSystem surface, and the overlays expose unfinished import names rather than completing those selected contracts.
